name: Stonestown Galleria
summary: Stonestown Galleria is a two-story regional shopping center in San Francisco featuring name-brand retailers, department stores, diverse dining options, and a premium Regal Cinemas theater. The mall is pet-friendly and currently undergoing an exciting transformation into a mixed-use neighborhood with new homes, parks, and enhanced community spaces.
demographics: Stonestown Galleria attracts a diverse mix of San Francisco residents and visitors, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households from the surrounding Sunset District, Parkmerced, and West Portal neighborhoods. The trade area draws families, young professionals, and students from nearby San Francisco State University, creating a balanced demographic profile spanning ages 25-65. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to both everyday necessities and specialty retail, with preferences for name-brand retailers and dining options that reflect San Francisco's multicultural population.
description: Stonestown Galleria stands as an iconic shopping destination in San Francisco's southwestern neighborhoods, serving the community as a comprehensive retail and entertainment hub since its establishment. This two-story enclosed regional mall features an impressive collection of name-brand retail shops, department stores, restaurants, and a state-of-the-art Regal Cinemas theater with ScreenX, 4DX, and RPX experiences. The center welcomes visitors with a pet-friendly policy, allowing dogs in designated stores, public spaces, and common areas, making it a truly inclusive community gathering place. Stonestown Galleria is currently embarking on an exciting transformation known as "Stonestown: The Next Chapter," which will gradually evolve this shopping destination into a vibrant, walkable mixed-use neighborhood featuring new residential homes, green spaces, parks, and a bustling main street that integrates retail, dining, and community amenities. With convenient hours throughout the week and extended Friday and Saturday shopping until 9:00 PM, Stonestown Galleria continues to serve as a cornerstone of San Francisco's retail landscape while embracing a forward-thinking vision for urban development.
